home.title: A Name, A Chance: Exploring Myanmar Refugee Issues Through Research and Stories
home.description: This website showcases my research and creative work on Myanmar refugees and related international issues, aiming to raise awareness about global refugee challenges through the integration of academic and artistic approaches.

researchReport.title: Research Report: Challenges and Reasons for Myanmar Refugees in Thailand in Employment
researchReport.summary: In-depth analysis of employment challenges faced by 3.33 million Myanmar refugees in Thailand, exploring informal employment, systematic exploitation, and identity restrictions.

handbook.title: Handbook: Refugee Employment, Education and Medication Guide
handbook.summary: Comprehensive visual guide for refugee employment assistance, covering legal rights, job search strategies, and community resources.

munProposal.title: MUN Proposal: Rohingya Crisis Proposal
munProposal.summary: A comprehensive MUN proposal addressing the Rohingya refugee crisis, focusing on international cooperation and sustainable solutions for refugee protection and resettlement.

rohingyaStudy.title: Background Research: A Case Study on Rohingya Refugee
rohingyaStudy.summary: A comprehensive case study examining the Rohingya refugee crisis, focusing on their displacement, challenges, and the broader context of Myanmar refugee issues.

designIntroduction.title: Design Philosophy & Process
designIntroduction.overview: This handbook represents a comprehensive approach to refugee assistance through thoughtful design and user-centered methodology.

principles.title: Design Principles
principles.accessibility: Universal Accessibility - Designed to be understood across language barriers and literacy levels
principles.clarity: Visual Clarity - Using clear icons, diagrams, and layouts to convey complex information simply
principles.cultural: Cultural Sensitivity - Respecting diverse backgrounds while providing practical guidance
principles.practical: Practical Utility - Focusing on actionable information that refugees can immediately use

process.title: Design Process
process.research: Research Phase - Extensive interviews with refugees, NGOs, and service providers to understand real needs
process.iteration: Iterative Design - Multiple rounds of testing and refinement based on user feedback
process.collaboration: Collaborative Approach - Working closely with refugee communities and organizations
process.testing: User Testing - Validating design decisions with actual refugee users

features.title: Key Design Features
features.multilingual: Multilingual Support - Available in multiple languages including English, Myanmar, and Thai
features.visual: Visual Hierarchy - Clear information architecture with logical flow and emphasis
features.interactive: Interactive Elements - QR codes and digital resources for extended information
features.portable: Portable Format - Designed for easy printing and distribution in refugee camps
